vol_state.skew_caveat: Measured on 493 sessions, skew against next-session range is rho -0.036, p 0.43 -- null in every vol tercile and in all four walk-forward folds, with tercile medians flat at 1.185 / 1.142 / 1.152 EM. Direction is null too (rho +0.05, p 0.28). An earlier 63-session read of rho +0.23, p 0.08 DID NOT SURVIVE the larger sample; it was a vol confound (skew vs ATM IV rho +0.595). Stamp it; never trade it as a rule.

nodes.weights_note: Equal by default and NOT fitted. Fitting them to reaction rate would be fitting to noise -- see `measured` below.
nodes.score_note: A ranking device for ATTENTION, not a probability of holding. MEASURED on 500 sessions and 4,556 node touches: this score does NOT rank reaction probability.

measured.scored_with: the five-component score (gamma, oi, proximity, persistence, structure); the seven-component score of 2026-09-12 is unmeasured
measured.verdict: NO EDGE over a distance-matched round-number placebo, and the quality buckets are NOT monotone. The ~57% is a property of the touch geometry, not of gamma. Nodes mark where hedging concentrates, not where price turns. This score decides which levels are worth showing; it does not say they hold.

scenarios.direction_note: Both directions are generated wherever structure allows. The engine supplies the map; the trigger is the tape committing. No scenario is emitted for one side because the gamma sign looked directional.

caveats: Structure and location are stated confidently; regime and range claims are not. The 60-session backtest found no support for a gamma sign implying a compressed or expanded range (p=0.46).

NODES DO NOT PREDICT REACTIONS. Measured on 500 sessions and 4,556 touches (2024-09 to 2026-09): scored nodes reacted 56.8% against 57.0% for a distance-matched round-number placebo, an edge of -0.2pp (z=-0.17), and the quality buckets are not monotone. The ~57% is the touch geometry, not gamma. These levels mark where hedging concentrates, not where price turns.
The rails are the one component with validation behind them: containment of the close ran 64-74% against a 68% target.
No confidence figure here is a probability. None has been calibrated against outcomes.

The dealer sign convention is an assumption, not an observation. `sign_convention` measures what the opposite book would change: the flips, the rails, the node ranking and the formations do not move; every sign and the gamma regime label do.
A level reached within minutes of a scheduled release is a release print, not a hedging reaction. Whether touches inside release windows behave differently is unmeasured.
